import sys

def main():
    input_string = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    
    n = len(input_string)
    
    # Check if the entire string is a palindrome of odd length
    if n % 2 == 1 and input_string == input_string[::-1]:
        print(1)
        print(1, n)
        return
    
    # Try to split the string into three parts: prefix, middle, and suffix
    # with the middle part being the longest possible palindrome of odd length
    max_length = 0
    best_split = None
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            substring = input_string[i:j]
            if len(substring) % 2 == 1 and substring == substring[::-1]:
                length = len(substring)
                if length > max_length:
                    max_length = length
                    best_split = (i + 1, length)
    
    if best_split:
        print(1)
        print(*best_split)
    else:
        # If no palindrome of odd length is found, split the string into three parts
        # with the middle part being a single character
        print(3)
        print(1, 1)
        print(2, n - 2)
        print(n, 1)
